messages.desktop.settings.transparency.detail: Glass surfaces that let the desktop and the window behind them show through, blurred. Off: solid surfaces (also when the system asks for reduced transparency).
messages.desktop.settings.gpu.detail: Draws the window with the graphics card where it can, which keeps it light on the processor. Turn it off if the window flickers or goes blank. Takes effect when Blitz restarts; if Blitz won't start at all, start it with BLITZ_GPU=off.
messages.desktop.files.doc_width_readable: Keep the document to a readable column
messages.desktop.settings.doc_css.detail: CSS for Markdown previews, over the defaults, for each theme. Set the --doc-* variables in the template, or style .preview-markdown .markdown directly.
